title: UK Summer Internship 2027 - Energy & Resources
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Baringa is looking for talented 2027 Summer Interns to join our Energy & Resources teams!

Our Internship

Our eight week Summer Internship Programme is designed to give you hands-on experience, meaningful responsibility, and a true insight into life at Baringa. Over the course of the programme, you’ll work alongside experienced consultants and specialists on real projects, develop valuable skills through tailored learning opportunities, and build connections across the business. Whether you’re exploring your career options or looking to kick-start your professional journey, our internship offers a supportive environment where you can learn, grow, and make an impact.

What's in it for you?

Well, it’s up to you. Baringa is what you make it.

Our Summer Internship Programme is designed to help you build your skills, expand your network, and gain first-hand experience of consulting. As well as making a meaningful contribution from day one, you'll have the chance to explore future career opportunities at Baringa, including the opportunity to be considered for a permanent Analyst role after graduation.

Our Summer Internship opportunities are available across a range of our Energy & Resources business units. Explore the summaries below to learn more about each team and discover where your skills and interests could make an impact. You can also find additional information about each team on our website.

Our Energy & Resources teams:

Retail, Networks & Water

Our clients across the sector rely on our deep utilities industry experience, knowledge and insight coupled with a hands-on, pragmatic delivery approach to solve their challenges. At Navista, our mission is to empower community oncology practices to deliver patient-centered cancer care. Navista, a Cardinal Health company, is an oncology practice alliance co-created with oncologists and practice leaders that offers advanced support services and technology to help practices remain independent and thrive. True to our name, our experienced team is passionate about helping oncology practices navigate the future.
The Senior Clinical Oncology Solutions Architect is a senior individual contributor position responsible for designing, building, integrating, and supporting clinical application solutions used by oncology practices across the Navista Network. This role works closely with architects, product managers, clinicians, vendors, and fellow engineers to deliver secure, scalable, and interoperable healthcare systems, with a strong emphasis on hands‑on engineering and operational excellence.
This position is ideal for an experienced Senior Engineer with deep healthcare systems experience who enjoys working at the intersection of clinical workflows, technology, and real‑world operations in a multi‑practice Oncology MSO environment.

title: Social Media Content Evaluator (Telugu)
description:
About the Role
In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis.
Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data.

Job Type: Freelance

Location: India (work from home)

Work Schedule: Part-time - 4 hours per day required. (Flexible schedule: you can choose your hours as long as the daily time requirement is met). Work whenever you want.

Start Date: Immediately

Duration: TBC

Rate: 6 USD per hour
What You’ll Do

•
Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present in the audio and on-screen text.

•
Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., verifying that the media content uses authentic target language and aligns with the cultural context of that language).

• Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines.

• Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models.

What we’re looking for:

• Must be currently living in India .

• Native-level written and spoken fluency in Telugu .

• Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop.

• Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines.

• (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

Vendor Type
When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.
Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?
A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to registered businesses in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

description:
Seven Red Lines is looking for a Mid-Senior Backend Engineer to join the core engineering team of a fast-growing Amsterdam startup in the e-commerce payments space.
The company manages disputes and chargebacks end-to-end for online merchants, integrating with e-commerce platforms, payment providers, fulfillment systems, and customer-support tools to collect evidence and resolve cases with payment providers and card networks. Following a successful pre-seed round, the company is now expanding its engineering team ahead of its next growth stage.
You will be employed by Seven Red Lines in Greece but work as an embedded member of the startup's core team . You will be one of its early engineers, with meaningful ownership over technical decisions , a short path from idea to production , and a visible impact on the product from the start. Joining at this stage also gives you the opportunity to grow with the company, taking on increasing technical ownership and potentially shaping the engineering team as it scales.
Responsibilities

•
Design and build API integrations with merchants' systems: e-shop platforms, payment service providers, fulfillment, and customer-support tools

•
Develop new features in the core backend platform, used daily by the internal operations team

•
Own your work end-to-end, from design through deployment, in a modern GCP environment

•
Build AI-powered automations into the platform to handle more dispute cases with less manual work

• Strong Python skills; hands-on experience with FastAPI (or a comparable framework)

• Comfortable working with little supervision in a small, fast-moving team

• Professional working proficiency in English

Good to have

• Good understanding of data warehousing (BigQuery)

description:
Work From Anywhere in LATAM

About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund. Candidates we've hired have been flown out to the US and EU to work with their clients, and even promoted to roles that match folks onshore in the US.
Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we're building for: Watch here
About the Client
A consumer products brand organization working across consumer electronics, wellness, and lifestyle categories is hiring a Packaging Designer to own packaging and visual design across its portfolio.
The client designs and ships physical products into retail, and treats packaging as a primary brand touchpoint rather than a container. Work runs on launch cycles, with external vendors and production partners involved in most projects.
About the Role
Day-to-day, the Packaging Designer leads packaging systems from concept through production, extends the brand's visual system across retail displays and campaign assets, and presents concepts to internal stakeholders and clients. Success means retail-ready packaging that holds up at print, and a visual system that stays consistent across packaging, retail, and marketing.
Core Responsibilities
Packaging Design & Production

• Lead packaging systems from concept through production across multiple product categories.

• Build dielines, artwork, and print-ready files that meet vendor and production specifications.

• Review proofs and press checks to confirm structural, material, and print accuracy.

• Track packaging projects against launch timelines and production deadlines.

Brand & Visual Systems

• Translate brand strategy into packaging and structural design solutions.

• Maintain visual systems that stay consistent across packaging, retail, and marketing.

• Extend brand identities across new product lines and consumer touchpoints.

Art Direction & Retail Assets

• Art direct product launches, packaging refreshes, and brand campaigns.

• Design retail displays, point-of-sale materials, and supporting brand assets.

• Keep retail-facing assets aligned with the live packaging system.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Presentation

• Work with marketing, product development, production, and external vendors on each launch.

• Present concepts and design rationale to internal stakeholders and clients.

• Manage feedback cycles and turn revisions around within project timelines.

Creative Leadership

• Mentor junior designers on packaging and production standards.

• Review team output against brand and print-quality standards.

• Document design standards and file conventions for reuse across projects.

Requirements

Must-Have

• 3+ years in packaging design, brand design, or creative direction with ownership from concept through production

• Portfolio showing at least 2-3 packaging systems that shipped to retail, covering both structural and graphic work

• Advanced Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe InDesign for dielines, artwork, and print layout

• Working knowledge of packaging structures, substrates, print processes, and production specifications

• Experience designing for consumer electronics, wellness, lifestyle, or consumer packaged goods brands

• Demonstrated development of brand identities extended across packaging, retail, and marketing touchpoints

• C1+ English (CEFR) for presenting concepts to client-side stakeholders

Nice-to-Have

• Adobe Dimension or Cinema 4D for 3D packaging mockups and visualization

• Figma for brand systems and cross-functional collaboration

• Retail merchandising and point-of-sale display design experience

We're hiring finance experts to evaluate AI-generated outputs related to transaction finance. title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
description:
At Ledgy , we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the role
As a Mid-level Software Engineer at Ledgy , you’ll build reliable, scalable product experiences that help companies manage their equity with confidence. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn complex equity workflows into clear, automated, user-friendly software.
This role is a strong fit if you’re ready to take ownership of well-scoped projects, grow your technical judgement, and contribute across the stack while learning from senior peers.
Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.
Teams we are hiring for:

•
Core Equity - Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy ’s equity engine. Every equity-related event - such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership - generates transactions. This team defines and maintains the transaction logic, data model, and core domain behaviour that ensure Ledgy ’s platform remains accurate, scalable, and compliant. They also enable employees to sell their shares seamlessly once vested.

•
Workflows & Automation - Focuses on automating complex equity workflows and integrating with third-party services, including the trading exchange. The team builds systems that help company admins efficiently onboard and offboard employees, automate equity grants and terminations.

•
Reporting - Transforms Ledgy ’s core equity data into financial, operational, and compliance reports. The team manages large, complex datasets and ensures reporting is accurate, performant, and reliable across jurisdictions and company structures. Their work powers the insights companies and auditors rely on for decision-making and transparency.

•
Tax - Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.

You will thrive in the role if you

• You have 3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer

• You are comfortable building and shipping production-quality features across the stack

• You enjoy learning complex domains and turning them into simple, maintainable product experiences

• You care about clean, tested, readable code and thoughtful collaboration

• You are curious about equity, financial workflows, and their real-world impact on companies and employees

• You’re excited to grow your technical judgement through code reviews, pairing, and architecture discussions

• You take ownership of your work while asking for input early when trade-offs are unclear

Our Tech Stack*:
We have a modern, cohesive stack that lets us move fast while maintaining quality:

•
Language: TypeScript

•
Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC

•
Backend: tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, Temporal

•
Infrastructure: GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions

Chainguard Containers is our core product, and we're hiring the leader for the team that builds it. This is a Director-track role reporting directly to the VP of Engineering for Containers, Libraries, and Repositories.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. Your team builds that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

You will own the team's outcomes end to end: the people, the roadmap partnership with Product, the technical bar, and delivery. • The image build pipeline: The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.

• Registry performance and distribution: Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.

• Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents: Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

title: Sales Strategy and Operations, M&A
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Go-to-Market (GTM) Operations team works across Corporate Planning, GTM Strategy, Product, and regional Strategy and Operations.

This role will lead the sales strategy and operations work associated with mergers and acquisitions (M&A). You’ll help assess how acquired businesses fit into Stripe’s GTM model and translate acquisition plans into clear operational changes across account placement, territories, coverage, quotas, compensation, reporting, systems, and seller enablement. You’ll partner closely with Corporate Development, Sales, Finance, Product, Product Marketing, Deal Desk, Legal, and regional Strategy and Operations teams to support due diligence, integration planning, launch readiness, and post-acquisition execution.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead the sales strategy and operations work required to assess and integrate acquisitions into Stripe’s GTM organization. You’ll develop integration plans, design operating models, coordinate cross-functional execution, and help sales teams successfully bring acquired products to market.

Responsibilities

• Partner with Corporate Development and GTM leaders during due diligence to assess sales motions, organizational structure, pipeline, customer segments, coverage models, systems, and operational risks

• Translate acquisition strategy into an executable GTM integration plan with clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, decision points, and success measures

• Design sales operating models for acquired products, including coverage, segmentation, account ownership, rules of engagement, lead routing, specialist support, partner motions, and customer expansion paths

• Evaluate how acquired teams, products, customers, and pipelines should connect with Stripe’s existing sales processes and rhythm of business

• Establish launch and integration readiness criteria covering seller readiness, systems and data, enablement, quoting, reporting, customer handoffs, and post-launch support

• Coordinate execution across Sales, Corporate Development, Finance, Product, Product Marketing, Enablement, Deal Desk, Legal, and systems teams

• Identify integration risks and execution gaps, recommend practical solutions, and escalate decisions with clear context and tradeoffs

• Develop reporting and operating mechanisms that help leaders monitor integration progress, field adoption, pipeline health, and business performance

• Support pricing, packaging, product catalog, quota, compensation, forecasting, and quote-to-cash workstreams in partnership with the relevant functional owners

• Help establish durable ownership for ongoing processes before work transitions out of the integration phase

• Build reusable due diligence, Day 1, Day 30, Day 90, launch readiness, and post-integration playbooks for future acquisitions

• Use data and qualitative insights to evaluate integration outcomes and recommend adjustments to GTM strategy and execution

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you’re encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

title: City Scout - Kuala Lumpur
description:
About Atlys
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
Atlys is changing that.
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries . But we’re still early.
The Role
We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers.
You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.
The Job

• Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

• Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable.

• Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes.

• Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality.

• Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted.

The Ideal Candidate
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

• Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule.

• Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

• Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

• Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

• Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.
What you can expect
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

• Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

• A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

• Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

• Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

• Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

• Great tools to do your best work , including high-spec equipment and software.

• An office designed for more than just work , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

We're looking for a Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)
You'll own iwoca 's most strategic partnerships in Germany, from the first conversation with a bank, payment provider or business software platform to a live integration that funds small businesses. Your mission is to bring fast, flexible finance to the places where SMEs already run their business.
The company
Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.
That's why we built iwoca . Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.
We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4.5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.
The team
The Partner Acquisition Germany team builds the partner channel through which iwoca reaches small businesses in Germany: comparison platforms and brokers, banks, payment providers, business software providers and financial advisors who offer iwoca 's finance to their customers at the moment it is needed. The team works with three partnership models, from a co-branded referral link and a partner portal to a full API integration, and measures its success by partners that are live and funding customers.
The team is small and works closely together: the Head of Partner Acquisition Germany, a Strategy & Data Manager who owns market analysis, business cases and the CRM, and the partner managers who own the relationships. The team prioritises partners by strategic fit, works through warm introductions and existing networks wherever possible, and stays close to every new partner until the first customers are funded. It works hand in hand with Relationship Management and the product and engineering teams in London / Berlin / Frankfurt that build the integrations.
The role
This is a senior role with full ownership of the partners you pursue. Three things matter more than anything else: You will qualify before you sell, because the best partnerships begin with a genuine customer need. You know how to activate networks and create warm introductions rather than relying solely on cold outreach. And you consider a deal complete only when the partnership is live, working well and funding its first customers. You'll travel across Germany one to two days a week for face-to-face partner meetings, industry events and trade fairs.

• Own your pipeline end to end and keep it transparent, so that forecasts and decisions rest on input and numbers everyone trusts.

title: Senior Development Fabrication Technician
tags: Hardware Platform : Hardware Engineering Services : Dev Fabrication
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Development Fabrication team within Mechanical Services turns early engineering concepts into physical hardware for some of Anduril’s highest-priority programs.

This is not a production line.

Our team builds low-volume, high-complexity prototype hardware - custom chassis, structural frames, fixtures, test articles, and complex weldments - often while designs are still evolving. Fabricators work directly with design engineers to determine how hardware should actually be built, identify problems before they reach integration, and rapidly turn ideas into functional hardware.

Every build is different. The drawings may change. The material may fight you. A design that works perfectly in CAD may not work on the shop floor. Our job is to figure it out - quickly, safely, and correctly.

The result is a highly collaborative prototype environment where experienced fabricators are trusted for their judgment, not simply handed a print and told to weld.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Development Fabrication Technician, you will take prototype hardware from drawing to finished assembly .

You’ll plan the build, select the right fabrication approach, lay out and fit components, weld and machine hardware, design fixtures, inspect your work, and solve problems as they emerge.

You will work directly with engineers when drawings are incomplete, tolerances create problems, or a design simply isn’t practical to manufacture. You’ll be expected to speak up, recommend a better path, and help the team get to the right hardware faster.

Some days you may fabricate a small precision assembly. Others may involve a large structural weldment or prototype supporting an entirely new vehicle or system.

This role is built for an experienced fabricator who wants complex problems, autonomy, variety, and ownership - not repetitive production work.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

•
Own prototype builds from start to finish , translating engineering drawings, CAD, and work orders into finished hardware ready for integration or testing.

•
Determine the best build sequence, fabrication approach, tooling, fixturing, and material preparation strategy for each job.

•
Fabricate small through large-scale assemblies using layout, fitting, welding, cutting, drilling, grinding, forming, sawing, and conventional machining.

•
Build complex weldments across steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and other alloys using GMAW, FCAW, and GTAW processes.

•
Design and build weld fixtures and tooling that maintain alignment and tight tolerances during fabrication.

•
Identify fit-up, tolerance, accessibility, distortion, sequencing, and manufacturability problems before they become integration problems .

•
Work directly with design engineers to resolve unclear drawings, incomplete designs, and manufacturability challenges.

•
Challenge designs when necessary and recommend practical changes that improve buildability, quality, and speed .

•
Perform dimensional and visual inspection of completed hardware and make sound decisions around rework, repair, or rebuild.

•
Independently execute R&D fabrication work with limited oversight, including evaluating the job, planning the work, identifying material needs, and completing the build.

•
Adapt quickly when designs, p

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

 

Маємо чудову можливість для тебе долучитися до одного з наших стрімко зростаючих бізнесів, який працює над social продуктами у сфері відеострімінгу.

Застосунки, які використовують наші рішення вже входять у топ свого сегменту, активно поширюються по всьому світу і мають понад 10 мільйонів завантажень. Ми впроваджуємо передові технології peer-to-peer аудіо та відеозв’язку, які використовуються в таких продуктах, як Telegram, WhatsApp та Google Meet.

Наші продукти активно зростають, а разом з ними зростає і наша команда. Саме тому ми шукаємо Product Analyst, який/яка допоможе знаходити точки росту і прискорити досягнення сміливих бізнес-цілей. Ми працюємо за транзакційною моделлю монетизації, а наші продукти включають велику кількість social interactions, що створює безліч викликів і запитань до аналітики.

Що будеш робити:

- Будеш генерувати продуктові ідеї і впливатимеш на бізнес. У тебе доступ до всіх продуктових зон і повна свобода копати там, де відчуваєш потенціал. Мінімум погоджень - результат своєї ідеї побачиш на метриках уже за кілька тижнів.

- Валідація продуктових гіпотез: продуктова команда генерує багато ідей, і твоя роль полягає в тому, щоб оцінити їх потенціал і правильно пріоритезувати.

- А/В-тестування: будеш супроводжувати тести повним циклом - від постановки гіпотези й дизайну експерименту до аналізу результатів і практичних рекомендацій бізнесу.

- Будеш налаштовувати event-based аналітику для нового функціоналу та покращувати її на вже існуючому, щоб коректно оцінювати вплив на поведінку користувачів.

Про тебе:

- 2+ роки досвіду в продуктовій аналітиці.

- Досвід роботи з А/В-тестами: від гіпотези й дизайну експерименту до аналізу результатів і рішення.

- Просунуті навички SQL та впевнена робота з інструментами візуалізації даних.

- Впроваджував автоматизацію в аналітичних процесах за допомогою AI-інструментів.

- У тебе високий рівень автономності: сам доводиш задачу до результату - від першого запитання до висновку, яким можна користуватись.

- Ти проактивний: не чекаєш, поки тобі поставлять задачу, а й сам знаходиш точки росту й ініціюєш дослідження.

- В тебе сильні комунікативні навички й вміння пояснювати складні дані мовою бізнесу

Буде плюсом:

- Досвід роботи з Amplitude та аналітикою мобільних застосунків.

- Досвід роботи з транзакційною моделлю монетизації

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

title: Senior / Staff Sensing Systems Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ ABOUT OUR ENGINEERING TEAMS

Wayve’s engineering teams are building the AI, robotics, simulation, data, and systems foundations needed to deploy a generalisable AI Driver safely and at scale.

ABOUT ROBOTICS SENSING

This role sits at the intersection of Robotics, Hardware, Vehicle Software, Machine Learning, Validation, and Product. As the first dedicated Sensing Systems Engineer in the team, you will help define how Wayve translates driving and model needs into sensing requirements and evidence across vehicle platforms.

🧠 YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

- Define and refine sensing-system requirements, metrics, and acceptance criteria for new and existing vehicle platforms.

- Translate product behaviours and use cases into measurable sensor needs and challenging validation scenarios.

- Design experiments with hardware, ML, and validation teams and analyse the resulting data.

- Evaluate how sensor characteristics, placement, calibration, synchronization, and defects affect model inputs and driving behaviour.

- Make and document system-level trade-offs across performance, cost, compute, packaging, reliability, and schedule.

- Drive cross-functional technical decisions where requirements are incomplete or conflicting.

🧩 WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

- Cameras, lidar, radar, localization, calibration, synchronization, and sensor-data quality.

- Sensing architectures for new vehicle platforms, from sensor selection and placement through interfaces and validation.

- Metrics and experiments that isolate sensor impact on end-to-end driving performance.

- Acceptance criteria and validation gates for on-road deployment.

- Cost and performance trade-offs for OEM and customer sensing configurations.

🙌 YOU SHOULD APPLY IF

- You have deep technical knowledge of at least one sensing modality used in robotics or autonomous vehicles.

- You bring strong systems-engineering fundamentals, including requirements definition, verification, and validation.

- You have designed experiments and used data analysis to make technical decisions.

- You understand how sensing limitations and failure modes propagate through a wider robotic or ML system.

- You work effectively across hardware, software, ML, validation, and product teams.

- Broad familiarity with calibration, synchronization, sensor fusion, perception, or automotive integration is beneficial; deep ML implementation experience is not required.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

MORE ABOUT WAYVE

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution from L2+ through to L4.

HOW WE WORK 💻 - LOCATIONS & FLEXIBLE WORKING

This role is based in Sunnyvale. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our offices, workshops, and vehicle environments with focused time working remotely.

🔍 THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

- Recruiter Screen (25 min)

- Initial technical screen covering experience, systems thinking, and cross-functional leadership (45 min)

- Deep Dives (Sensor Fundamentals, ML Sensor Interface, Architecture & Systems Engineering, Technical Leadership; 3-4 hours)

- Final covering values and mission alignment (45 min)

title: AI Engineer (Computer Vision and Applied GenAI)
description:
Location: Amman, Jordan. Fully remote.
Type: Full-time, permanent.
Level: Mid-level, roughly 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience.
Languages: English required. German is a strong plus.
About the role
We are looking for an AI Engineer based in Amman who will work remotely with a distributed engineering team. This is a builder role, not a research role. You will take AI capabilities from prototype to something that runs reliably in production, and you will own your work end to end: the model, the data around it, the service that serves it, and the evidence that it actually works.
The work spans two areas. On one side, computer vision and perception: camera pipelines, object detection and recognition, and inference that has to run fast and stay stable. On the other, applied generative AI: LLM-based features, retrieval, agents, and the evaluation harnesses that keep them honest. You will not be handed a narrow slice of either. You will be expected to move between them and to build the plumbing that connects them to a real product.
Tasks

• Design, train, fine-tune and evaluate models for vision tasks (detection, classification, segmentation, tracking) and integrate them into production pipelines.

• Build LLM-powered features: retrieval-augmented generation, tool-using agents, structured extraction, and the prompt and evaluation infrastructure behind them.

• Write the services around the models: APIs, data pipelines, batch and streaming jobs, storage.

• Optimise for the target hardware, including quantisation, batching, and inference on edge devices where cloud inference is not an option.

• Define and track quality metrics. Establish a baseline before claiming an improvement, and be able to show where a number came from.

• Instrument, monitor and debug models in production: drift, latency, failure modes, and the unglamorous work of finding out why a pipeline broke at 3am.

• Work directly with product and business stakeholders to turn a vague need into a scoped, measurable deliverable.

• Document what you build so that the next engineer does not have to reverse-engineer it.

Requirements

• 3 to 5 years building and shipping machine learning or AI systems in production. Personal projects and Kaggle notebooks alone will not cover this.

• Strong Python. Clean, tested, reviewable code, not notebook-only output.

• Practical depth in at least one of the two areas below, and working familiarity with the other:

•
Computer vision: PyTorch or TensorFlow, OpenCV, modern detection and segmentation architectures, dataset creation and annotation workflows.

•
Applied GenAI: LLM APIs and open-weight models, RAG, embeddings and vector stores, agent frameworks, prompt design, and systematic evaluation.

• Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, code review, testing, CI, Docker, and comfort on the Linux command line.

• Experience deploying a model as a service and keeping it running, including cloud deployment (AWS, Azure or GCP) and basic observability.

• SQL and general data handling: you can find, clean and reason about the data before modelling it.

• Fluent written and spoken English, and the self-direction that remote work requires. You are comfortable writing things down, flagging blockers early, and working without someone checking in on you hourly.

Strong plus

•
German language skills. Part of the team and a meaningful share of the documentation, meetings and stakeholder communication are in German. Any level from solid B1 upward is a real advantage, and it will widen the scope of what you can own. It is not a hard requirement, and we will support you in improving it.

• Edge and embedded inference: NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO.

• Video streaming and industrial camera work: RTSP, GStreamer, GenICam, machine vision cameras.

• MLOps tooling: MLflow, Weights and Biases, DVC, Kubernetes, model registries.

• Experience in an industrial, robotics, IoT or B2B product environment.

You will use agentic tools to apply those skills faster and at greater scale without compromising testing depth or judgment.
You will design and maintain automated test suite, improve our quality engineering frameworks and delivery pipelines, and expand the use of AI agents within our QA processes. This includes creating, configuring and using agentic tools to accelerate test creation, analysis, failure triage, coverage assessment, and other recurring quality workflows.
As our product and software development practices become increasingly AI-native, you will also contribute to how we validate AI-powered features. Having direct experience testing AI agents, LLM-based features, or other non-deterministic systems is a strong asset.
What You Will Do
Quality engineering & automated testing
Apply strong testing fundamentals and heuristics to identify product risks, edge cases, failure modes, and gaps in expected behaviour Investigate failures and unexpected behaviour and act of them. Configure and use agentic tools with various degree of autonomy, to accelerate test creation, maintenance, analysis, failure triage, and other recurring QA activities. Advocate for testability and quality throughout the development lifecycle. Improve the reliability, performance, and scalability of our test frameworks, internal tooling, and automated quality gates. Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically and ensure appropriate validation and human oversight remain part of the testing process.
Testing AI-powered systems
Contribute to test strategies for AI-powered, LLM-based, and agentic product capabilities. Help define how non-deterministic behaviour should be evaluated, including expected behaviour, quality thresholds, regression approaches, and failure analysis. Validate areas such as model responses, tool usage, grounding, consistency, error handling, latency, and end-to-end agent behaviour where applicable.
Collaboration & continuous improvement
Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and other technical teams to make quality an integral part of software development. Share testing patterns, tools, and lessons learned, and continuously look for ways to improve testing effectiveness and delivery speed.
Required Qualifications
Strong software testing fundamentals, such as critical thinking, exploratory testing, test design, risk-based testing, common testing heuristics, and the ability to reason about customer and product impact. Hands-on experience designing and developing automated tests for modern software applications. Strong programming skills in at least one language commonly used for test automation or engineering, such as TypeScript/JavaScript or Python. Experience with modern test automation frameworks Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and incorporating automated testing into software delivery workflows. Ability to troubleshoot complex software and automated test failures across application, test, data, and infrastructure layers. Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development capabilities to automate or improve engineering and QA workflows. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across QA, Engineering, Product, and other technical teams. A continuous-improvement mindset and an interest in finding better ways to make software quality faster, more scalable, and more reliable.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based features, copilots, or autonomous or agentic systems. Experience developing evaluation frameworks or automated evaluations for non-deterministic AI
